CLIP (with atom IDs): E05.012 | 00:22.00-00:28.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on Corin as the lamp flickers behind them.
E05.013 | 00:22.20-00:28.00 | ACT | Corin draws a short blade from a boot.
E05.014 | 00:22.40-00:25.44 | DLG | SELENE (mocking, venomous) | "A lamp-keeper's girl in my mother's lace? Never!"
E05.015 | 00:28.00-00:32.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E05.016 | 00:28.40-00:31.44 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (nervous, triumphant) | "Take the girl to the cells until morning."
E05.017 | 00:32.00-00:38.00 | CAM | Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.
E05.018 | 00:32.40-00:35.06 | DLG | MARA (tender, broken) | "Then let them come with their torches!"
E05.019 | 00:38.00-00:44.00 | CAM | Medium two-shot of Corin and the Mayor, the space between them charged.
E05.020 | 00:38.20-00:44.00 | ACT | Corin slaps the cup from the Mayor's hand and it shatters.
E05.021 | 00:38.40-00:41.44 | DLG | SELENE (panicked, sweet) | "A lamp-keeper's girl in my mother's lace? Never!"
E05.022 | 00:42.50-00:44.00 | SFX | Thunder cracks over the harbour.
E05.023 | 00:44.00-00:47.00 | CAM | High wide shot of the crowded hall turning toward the door.
E05.024 | 00:44.20-00:47.00 | ACT | Tobin tears the lace veil and lets it fall.
E05.025 | 00:44.40-00:46.80 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (pompous, triumphant) | "The council has already decided her fate."
E05.026 | 00:47.00-00:48.00 | CAM | Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.
E05.027 | 00:48.00-00:52.00 | CAM | Close-up on Selene's jaw tightening.
E05.028 | 00:48.40-00:51.44 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (furious, venomous) | "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
E05.029 | 00:52.00-00:58.00 | CAM | Over-the-shoulder shot from the widow toward Corin.
E05.030 | 00:52.40-00:55.44 | DLG | SELENE (mocking, venomous) | "A lamp-keeper's girl in my mother's lace? Never!"
E05.031 | 00:58.00-01:03.00 | CAM | Medium two-shot of Tobin and Selene, the space between them charged.
E05.032 | 00:58.20-01:03.00 | ACT | Tobin tears the lace veil and lets it fall.
E05.033 | 00:58.40-00:59.92 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (cold, silken) | "Drink deep, little lamp-keeper."
E05.034 | 01:03.00-01:06.00 | CAM | Medium two-shot of Selene and the widow, the space between them charged.
E05.035 | 01:03.40-01:05.30 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (cold, triumphant) | "Lord Ashvale? That is impossible."
KEY REVEALS OF THE SHOW: R01 (E1): [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her
R02 (E2): [mock] The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain
R03 (E3): [mock] On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family
R04 (E4): [mock] Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship
R05 (E5): [mock] Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast
R06 (E6): [mock] The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara
R07 (E7): [mock] Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant
R08 (E8): [mock] Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room
